research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen occupations, official indexed biography, first speech, contemporary parliamentary witness record and 2019 election guide cross-checked. Searches for employer annual reports, Terravision, consulting history and full-time evidence produced no reliable individual hours/leave record. Unrelated overseas namesakes excluded.

Follow-up: apprenticeship employer/terms and dates; possible gaps 1999–2000 and 2007–2008; other community employers within eight-year narrative; church payroll and legal entities; foundation 2018 departure versus 2019 present-tense biography; consultancy entity/clients/hours/2019 cessation; 2016 and 2019 campaign leave and all overlaps.

Considering theology/ministry in his twenties is not evidence of completed study or pastor employment. Relative eight-year youth-work narrative does not license invented endpoints. Year boundaries and missing hours preclude exact union-duration calculations.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: official biography, public professional-profile index, government June 2018 discussion paper and archived-panel page. Corrected existing source references: official qualifications/party/occupation biography is src-4, whereas src-3 is the 2017 witness list.

GenerationOne departure conflict resolved at year level by contemporary government footnote; own profile further reports January 2018, but precise employment/foundation separation still needs employer confirmation. 2008 foundation entry versus January 2013 COO title requires earlier role descriptions; do not erase earlier service.

Full-time searches returned unrelated designer, journalist, US MBA and Irish property-agent namesakes; none assigned. Direct professional-profile access returned (999) Unknown Status Code; only legitimately public indexed entries used. Apprenticeship employer/terms, church pay, consultancy legal entity/clients and campaign leave remain unresolved. Advisory-panel remuneration/contract and whether delivered through consultancy remain follow-up priorities.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: targeted Terravision, church-employer and O'Sullivan Consulting searches produced no attributable personnel, payroll, legal-entity or client record beyond the sources already captured. ABN results for WJ O'Sullivan Consulting Pty Ltd (NSW), O'Sullivan Consulting Pty Ltd (Victoria) and other similarly named businesses were rejected because they do not identify this senator. No dates or hours were changed; advance to the next member rather than repeat exhausted name-only searches.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted 2008–2011 foundation/GenerationOne chronology, apprenticeship and consultancy searches. Official Liberal biography and 2016 ABC election guide repeat 2008 foundation entry without earlier titles, payroll hours or leave. Public LinkedIn associate project confirms direction by Matthew O Sullivan in June2014, within an already documented COO interval, so no new employment spell. Irish/media/film/medical namesakes rejected. Consultancy identity, apprenticeship terms and the 1999–2000/2007–2008 transitions remain unverified; retain prior primary department resolution of 2018 GenerationOne cessation rather than stale later bios. Next useful avenue: historical foundation personnel reports and individual contract/leave material, not repeated name-only ABN searches.

Follow-up2026-10-05: targeted historical foundation/GenerationOne2009–2011 personnel and full-identity Matthew Anthony O Sullivan consultancy searches did not recover an earlier role, legal consultancy entity, hours or apprenticeship terms. UK school-trust/finance directors, building consultant, Melbourne actor and NSW doctor are namesakes, not this senator. Own first speech again corroborates2008 foundation entry without further title progression; no stale2019 present-tense COO wording adopted. Keep prior resolved2018 departure. Advance rather than repeat broad employer/name searches; follow-up needs original employment/contract and historical foundation personnel records.
